Freshness check fused into the first task read; after repair the reused probe observation is charged once (one repair_attempts, one repair probe fetch, one post-repair verify); first task id NOT re-resolved/re-fetched/re-verified. Timed per episode (t_reuse) in parity order against cold episodes.

decision_rule: Per class c in {P1-ENDPOINT,P2-STRUCTURE,P3-PERMISSION}, n>=12 valid trials, functional_ok (repair_success>=0.80 AND wilson_lower>=0.60 AND contamination<=0.10 AND write_set_max<=1 AND guard_fire>=0.80) required. eq := pr_L2<1.00 AND pr_L3<1.00 AND fetch_L3<=0.90 (equal-weight strict win, parent semantics). cw := calibrated_win (measured-weight reuse<cold at BOTH L2 and L3 under the independently calibrated weights). lw := R_L2<1.00 AND R_L3<1.00 (median episode-latency ratios). cost_verdict first match: FUNCTIONAL-FAIL if !functional_ok; STRICT-WIN-MEASURED if eq AND cw AND lw; SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED if eq AND (cw XOR lw); EQUAL-ONLY-MIXED if eq alone; BOUNDED-WIN if pr<=1.00 both and fetch<=0.90; MIXED-TRADEOFF if max(pr)<=1.15 and fetch<=0.90; COST-FAIL otherwise; COST-UNKNOWN on None. Aggregate first match: any validity gate fails (V0 pin, V1 freeze, V2 isolation, V3' determinism-projection, V4 bite, V5 cold live, V6 inert, V7 guard, V8 leakage, V9 integer counters, V10 not-fitted, V11 n=12, V12 base-liveness every trial, V13 legacy regression, V14 reuse identity, V15 overbroad live, V-CALIB construction, V-TIMING warmup/order/finite) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE; all STRICT-WIN-MEASURED -> SUPPORTS; all in {STRICT-WIN-MEASURED,SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED} -> MIXED-PARTIAL; all in positive/neutral tiers -> MIXED-COUNTER-DEPENDENT; some positive/neutral -> MIXED; else FALSIFIES. Outcome: SUPPORTS->SUPPORTS, MIXED*->MIXED, FALSIFIES->FALSIFIES, INCONCLUSIVE->INCONCLUSIVE.
estimated_cost: CPU-only, stdlib-only, no downloads, no external API spend. Stage A calibration (~1200 local ops, seconds) + 36 trials x (2 warmup + 8 arms) on an in-process localhost server + NC trials: ~15-50 minutes wall clock, negligible memory. No credential, model, browser or network dependency.
expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing in both directions; resolves the exact unknown the parent handoff and the Director mandate leave open. The parent packet (audit PASS, MIXED) proved the strict equal-weight win is counter-dependent (M-WEIGHT-ROBUST-BOTH 0.78/0.67 < 1.0) but could not say whether the equal-weight counter itself is product-correct. This packet constructs the missing object: an independently time-calibrated per-operation counter plus the end-to-end episode-latency surface. SUPPORTS (both measured surfaces win at L2+L3 on all classes) re-admits localized repair to the product story WITH a stated measured counter; EQUAL-ONLY-MIXED or measured loss confirms the counter-dependence as a genuine product-economics boundary and permanently drops local repair from C-PRODUCT-ECON; construction failure (V-CALIB) maps to drop-pending-counter per the mandate. No existing packet provides any of these branches; the design is not an equal-weight-only rerun (mandate stop-trigger honored).
falsifier: With H1 and a LIVE H2 instrument established on every class: the mandate's re-admission claim FAILS (no re-admit) if, under the independently calibrated counter, the reuse-vs-cold comparison is >= 1.00 at L=2 OR at L=3 (no calibrated_win), or if the median episode-latency ratio is >= 1.00 at L=2 or L=3 (no latency_win) - i.e. the equal-weight strict win does not survive product-correct accounting (EQUAL-ONLY-MIXED / measured-loss reading: counter-dependence is a genuine boundary, drop from product story). It FAILS differently if the equal-weight strict win itself does not reproduce (BOUNDED-WIN or worse: challenges even the parent's bounded win). Construction failure (V-CALIB: calibration workload non-live, medians non-positive/non-finite, timer insufficient, or RSE above bar) yields no scientific verdict (MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE, never falsification) with product consequence drop-pending-counter. Any insensitive control (overbroad <= 0.10, base-liveness miss, cold/literal/norepair off-spec, guard false-fire, pin mismatch, order/warmup violation) is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a negative.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Denominator fixed in advance to B-COLD (same carrier re-derivation); never the abstention control, never the fetch ratio alone. Treatment shares carrier/substrate/seeds/perturbations with baseline and differs only in physical resolve/fetch/verify counts for the first task id, directly evidenced by per-operation logs (V14). Conservative/legacy arms are reported sensitivities excluded from the classifier (legacy only as replication premise V13). Neither counter is re-tuned: equal-weight preserved for reproduction; measured weights come from the independent calibration workload, and the robustness band only reports sign changes around measured weights.

control_sensitivity.reason: Distinct non-tautological controls per failure mode, all verified live at DESIGN: PC-BASE-LIVENESS scored in-trial (smoke: true); B-LITERAL-REPLAY/B-NO-REPAIR must-fail; NC-NO-PERTURBATION/NC-NOISE must-not-fire; NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR live (smoke 4/4; parent 4/4 every trial; DESIGN liveness in-support 200-verified on all resources, out-of-support id=1 NO-RESOLVE everywhere). New gates: V0 substrate pin (v2 hash+bytes verified, import works), V-TIMING (2 warmups/trial, exact 6/6 parity order per class, finite timings). No control is given the treatment answer.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: The frozen pure classifier was driven with synthetic rows at DESIGN (non-substrate, non-outcome-bearing): all 8 class branches {STRICT-WIN-MEASURED, SINGLE-SURFACE-MIXED, EQUAL-ONLY-MIXED, BOUNDED-WIN, MIXED-TRADEOFF, COST-FAIL, FUNCTIONAL-FAIL, COST-UNKNOWN} and all 6 aggregates {SUPPORTS, MIXED-PARTIAL, MIXED-COUNTER-DEPENDENT, MIXED, FALSIFIES, INCONCLUSIVE} produced (all True). Calibrated arithmetic both sides exist (parent P1 vectors win under time-order weights, lose under repair-heavy weights). No bar sits at/below a structural floor: bars are strict inequalities on live quantities; the 81-combo band is informational, not a gate. The two-surface conjunction keeps both SUPPORTS and MIXED reachable (latency noise genuinely flippable at ~5-15% effect size).

(all re-verified at DESIGN). The executable v3 driver is embedded verbatim in prereg.md section 12 and bound by CANONICAL-RUNNER-V3-SHA256 plus freeze hashes. No external bank/dataset/fixture needed. Nothing assumed.

Success rates at the 1.0 ceiling are functional gates, not the measured advantage: the cost dynamic range is live (17 vs 18/19/20) and latency adds a continuous surface. hypothesis: H1 (functional/locality gates, re-attested): after a single LOCAL perturbation, reuse-based signal-driven local repair restores success on ALL FIVE TASK_IDS at rate >= 0.80 per class (Wilson lower >= 0.60), guard fires >= 0.80, write_set_max <= 1, same-target contamination <= 0.10 with the corrected in-support probe, overbroad rewrite detected > 0.10. H2 (calibrated counter): under the independently time-calibrated per-operation counter (weights from Stage-A calibration medians, numeraire fetch=1.0), reuse product is STRICTLY below cold at BOTH L=2 and L=3. H3 (end-to-end latency): median timed-episode latency ratio reuse/cold is STRICTLY below 1.00 at BOTH L=2 and L=3. H4 (construction): the calibration workload is live and yields finite positive medians with RSE <= 0.30 and timer resolution <= 1us; model_calls/model_tokens are structurally 0 (no LLM on substrate; B3-gated real model economics remains unknown, not measured). H5 (replication premise): T-REPAIR-LEGACY still reproduces the prior regression (ratio > 1.00 at L=2) and the equal-weight strict win reproduces (ratios ~0.944/0.895, fetch ~0.56-0.67).

null_control.failure_policy: Any false-firing guard -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Insensitive overbroad -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID (the parent F1 failure must not recur). Calibration-construction failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE (mandate maps to drop-pending-counter), never a scientific negative.
null_control.protocol: NC-NO-PERTURBATION: guard on unperturbed body must be fresh (stale=false). NC-NOISE: observed_at churn must not fire. NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR: target repaired postconditions applied to ALL mechanisms; in-support probe on 4 unaffected resources must flag breakage (>0.10). V-CALIB: independent calibration workload (300 timed fetch/resolve/verify/repair-bookkeeping ops on unperturbed substrate) must yield finite positive medians with RSE<=0.30. V-TIMING: parity episode order (6/6 per class), 2 excluded warmups per trial, finite latencies.
null_control.success_criterion: NC-NO-PERTURBATION stale=false AND NC-NOISE stale=false; overbroad rate > 0.10 with probes>0; calib_ok=true; order balance exact; warmups==72; timed errors==0.

members.protocol: Inside every scored trial: boot substrate, distill from LEARN_IDS via shipped distill_parameterized, then for each of five resources resolve+fetch+verify in-support probe id 14 against the live server BEFORE perturbation.
members.success_criterion: all five return (200, id, verified=True); base_liveness=true for the trial.

members.protocol: Non-outcome-bearing DESIGN probe: same distill+verify plus corrected-vs-degenerate instrument comparison, timer check, mini-calibration (N=60).
members.success_criterion: server_ready, distill_live, task_read_verified, contamination_instrument_live, out_of_support_probe_degenerate, timer 1ns, mini-calib medians finite>0.

positive_control.success_criterion: pre-perturbation, in EVERY scored trial, all five learned mechanisms resolve EXECUTABLE and verify on the in-support probe (base_liveness=true); aggregate true-trials == total. Attestation inside the scored artifact.

product_consequence_negative: If EQUAL-ONLY-MIXED (equal-weight strict win reproduces but calibrated_win is false and/or latency_win is false) or any measured-loss tier: the counter-dependence is CONFIRMED as a genuine product-economics boundary under product-correct accounting; localized repair must be permanently dropped from the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story (it is network-fetch-cheaper only, not end-to-end-cheaper) before the flagship is funded. If BOUNDED-WIN/MIXED-TRADEOFF/COST-FAIL/FALSIFIES: even the bounded equal-weight win does not hold; drop a fortiori and challenge the parent's bounded win. If MEASUREMENT_INVALID via V-CALIB construction failure (calibration live-requirements unmet, weights indeterminate): no scientific verdict on reuse-vs-cold; per the Director mandate, localized repair cannot be re-admitted and stays dropped from the product story pending a valid independently-justified counter (product decision under uncertainty, not falsification). If MEASUREMENT_INVALID otherwise: no product decision; the blocker is the instrument, not another run of the same design.
product_consequence_positive: If decision=SUPPORTS (all classes STRICT-WIN-MEASURED: equal-weight strict win reproduces AND calibrated_win AND latency_win at L=2 and L=3 with all validity gates incl. V0/V-CALIB/V-TIMING passing): the parent's counter-dependence was an artifact of unjustified weightings no external agent uses; reuse-based localized repair is strictly end-to-end-cheaper under the stated measured counter and is RE-ADMITTED to the product story for the shipped carrier with the stated counter (weights + latency surface) and explicit scope bounds (credential-free stdlib substrate; no model-call economics - B3 still gates the flagship). Whether C-DELTA-REPAIR advances beyond EXPERIMENTAL remains DIRECTOR adjudication; runtime lane cannot promote (promote_to_product=false).
question: On the same fetch-scarce, credential-free, locally served substrate and the same shipped carrier held fixed (src/spider/kernel.py: distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify), with the corrected in-support contamination instrument retained: can an independently justified end-to-end product-economics counter - time-calibrated per-operation weights (numeraire: measured fetch cost) plus measured end-to-end episode latency, with model calls/tokens structurally 0 (B3 NOT SATISFIED, carried as unknown) - be constructed and measured so that reuse-based localized repair is or is not strictly cheaper than cold re-derivation at L=2 and L=3, i.e. is the observed equal-weight counter-dependence a genuine product-economics boundary or an artifact of an equal-weight counter no external agent actually uses, and should localized repair therefore be permanently dropped from the C-PRODUCT-ECON product story?
title: Independently time-calibrated per-operation counter plus measured end-to-end episode latency for reuse-based localized repair vs cold re-derivation at L=2/L=3: does the strict win survive product-correct accounting, or is the counter-dependence a genuine boundary? (C-DELTA-REPAIR CONTINUE / USE)
